environment.shell: PowerShell 7.6.10; ACL helper also executed through Windows PowerShell

checks.detail: All 17 repository tests passed, including Windows private ACL creation/rejection, no-overwrite behavior, directory-junction escape rejection and synthetic HTTP/SSE checks. Original Linux material hashes were restored exactly by LF normalization, without rewriting the original evidence.

The existing proxy had no listener and used an old static catalog. Its inspected launcher restored loopback-only health 200, no-key 401 and keyed models 200. Refreshed 13 eligible entries matched model/list from the actual extension's bundled app-server. The provider/defaults and startup value were unchanged. The earlier process disappearance remains unexplained.

Clean locked installation stopped at the configured mirror's HTTP 404 for pkce-challenge 5.0.2. The official registry failed TLS negotiation through Node and Windows curl. The pinned gateway's four original tests were not executed; no dependency or TLS workaround was substituted.

The pre-existing alternative proxy remained responsive after starting its inspected launcher; its original Run entry was preserved. No reference-gateway Windows service was installed, and no logout/reboot was performed.

Local key-file ACLs and authenticated metadata access of the existing command-authenticated proxy were checked. The reference gateway's config.json/auth.json login layout was not deployed or claimed to pass.

The existing proxy's catalog and the actual extension's 13-model result agreed; the preserved default model advertised its configured high effort. This does not certify the pinned reference gateway's two HTTP catalog endpoints on Windows.
No real model request was sent because quota permission was unavailable.
No independent CLI inference probe was authorized or performed.
Bundled app-server initialize/model/list passed without a thread or turn; it is not a CLI inference probe.
GUI control was disabled and the user unavailable. The active VS Code window was not reloaded or treated as verified.

limitations: This is bounded maintenance and metadata evidence from an existing alternative proxy, not a successful fresh Windows installation of the pinned gateway.
No account authorization, key rotation, paid inference, real response.completed, CLI turn or GUI conversation was performed.
The refreshed catalog's historical compatibility exclusions were preserved, not revalidated.
A current-user Run entry and a live detached process do not prove crash supervision, logout survival or reboot recovery.
Root maintenance tooling and CI changes are not hashed by this package-local material map; the Windows CI job has not been run by publishing these local changes.
Private target paths, startup backups, raw logs and credentials are intentionally excluded.
